title: A Mesoporous Carbon-Supported and Cs-promoted Ru Catalyst with Enhanced Activity and Stability for Sustainable Ammonia Synthesis
extraction_notes: No catalyst-performance entries for ammonia synthesis are reported in the supplied Supporting Information. SI Scheme S1 (page 3) shows the reaction apparatus and rate-calculation equation but gives no catalyst-specific measured rate, outlet NH3 concentration, TOF, or reaction-condition data. SI Figure S1 and SI Figure S2 are characterization data and are out of scope.
